name: wf-review
description: wf PR-review feature pack — a native, user-invoked feature capability shipping the address-pr, review-pr and sweep-pr skills. Reads and posts PR review comments and CI results, and sweeps a merged PR for review threads that landed after the merge, entirely through the wf capability-registry's delivery provider (no git/gh strings of its own), treats review-tool output as hypothesis and verifies every claim against real code, files verified survivors through the active tracker, and optionally distils bulk comment/CI via wf:context-distiller. Composes natively on install for its three skills; the pr-review capability itself must be registered via /wf-review:init for its ship.review and fleet.closeout-review slot fills to resolve.
